{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Dark green velvet-effect midi skirt, A-line cut, falling just below the knee, emerald #0B5D4B, stretch velvet with a soft sheen
Fitted turtleneck sweater, slim cut, hip length, ivory #F2E8D5, fine merino wool
Tailored wool-blend coat, belted, calf length, deep burgundy #7A1F3D, brushed wool with a water-repellent finish
Knee-high boots, block heel of moderate height, sleek round toe, black #1A1A1A, waterproof leather with a rubber sole
Opaque tights, 100 denier, black #121212, soft microfiber
Oversized sturdy umbrella, wind-resistant, black #1C1C1C, nylon canopy with a fiberglass frame
Statement earrings, sculptural gold drops, polished gold #C9A24B, brass with gold plating
Small structured crossbody bag, glossy, cobalt blue #1F4FBF, patent leather with a gold chain strap

This outfit works because the rich emerald skirt, burgundy coat and cobalt bag make a bold, confident color story that stands out in a cinema crowd, while the ivory knit keeps it polished and balanced. The look stays neat and refined, with a soft velvet texture and sleek boots that suit an evening out and a dinner afterward. For the cold, rainy and windy evening, the warm merino, thick tights and the water-repellent belted coat keep her comfortable, and waterproof boots with a sturdy umbrella handle the downpour. The crossbody bag keeps her hands free for the umbrella and tickets."}
